english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person's feeling of remorse after doing something wrong.
This is the all-purpose everyday noun for the guilty feeling of remorse.
Use this when the qualm is specifically a pang of guilt or troubled conscience rather than a general reservation.

examples.english: I still feel guilt about it.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dou3 ji4 gaa1 zung6 jau5 noi6 gau3 gam2

examples.english: After doing something wrong, I felt remorse all night.
I have a qualm about eating the cake my colleague left behind.
examples.traditional: 我食咗同事留低嘅餅，心裏一直有內疚感。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 zo2 tung4 si6 lau4 dai1 ge3 beng2 sam1 leoi5 jat1 zik6 jau5 noi6 gau3 gam2
